notes.the-commons: The Commons is two OSM buildings, The Commons Building 1 and Building 2, neither named for the hall alone; pinned inside Building 2 (way/405170128), in the middle of its north wing (UNG Residence Life, ung.edu/residence-life/halls/the-commons.php).
notes.the-commons-building-1: The other half of The Commons residence hall, not a dining hall (its name only says commons).
notes.memorial-hall: Memorial Hall is the gym (UNG's venue page "Memorial Hall Gym", ung.edu/campuses/dahlonega/Venues/memorial-hall-gym.php).
notes.materials-management: Receiving and warehouse, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.downtown-office-building-ung: An office building, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.alumni-house: The alumni relations house, not somewhere classes happen.
notes.coleman-fieldhouse-ung: The baseball and softball teams' fieldhouse (dedicated March 2014, UNG Athletics), not somewhere classes happen.

detours.why: OSM maps no door on Patriot Hall, so its walks start from the walkway on its north side; to the Convocation Center they go west round the hall and down the diagonal footpath (no path is mapped across its south side), and to Wynne-Mathews they go east round Gaillard Hall, which stands between them, by the road.

The Drill Field lies between Gaillard Hall and Dunlap Hall, and OSM maps only the oval path round it, not across; Gaillard has no mapped door and starts from the road south of it, so the walk goes round the west side of the field.
